issues.description: The general growth-bound statement omits sign/domain hypotheses. For arbitrary rates and an even horizon, ordering r does not order (1+r)^n; negative principal also reverses inequalities. Positive historical example rates make the actual worked arithmetic valid.
issues.fix: State P≥0, n a nonnegative integer, and r_i≥−1 (or positive growth factors), with weights nonnegative summing to one.

issues.description: The first compact-image proof is valid for any compact space; the optional maximizing-sequence proof additionally assumes sequential compactness, which arbitrary compact spaces need not have.
issues.fix: Delete the optional sequence argument or say compact metric space there. This does not invalidate the first proof.

issues.description: Chern-number arithmetic is correct using a real-valued curvature convention c1=[F/(2π)]. For a unitary line-bundle connection the actual skew-Hermitian curvature is i times this real two-form; the convention is not explicit in the definition.
issues.fix: Declare F to be the real curvature form with c1=[F/(2π)], or write the unitary curvature as 2πi(n dx1∧dx2+m dx3∧dx4) and c1=[F/(2πi)].

approved_scopes: Gaussian construction proves almost-sure and L² convergence from trace summability. Identity covariance fails by the strong law. The text correctly does not claim to prove the general Sazonov theorem or identify Cameron–Martin support with sample support.

TL factorization proof is exact for a declared relation ideal. Rank-one projection example satisfies finite TL3 relations at δ≥1; no unjustified affine-to-finite quotient is asserted, and nonfaithful representations at special parameters are distinguished from diagram-basis independence.

Harper H has norm at most4 and is self-adjoint. Flux periodicity/reflection and the phase-union energy-reflection identity have the correct signs. The half-flux two-site fiber has eigenvalues ±sqrt(4cos²θ+|1+e^ik|²), touches at θ=π/2,k=π, and phase-union range ±2sqrt2. No irrational spectral type or GUE/RH consequence is imported.
IDS rational label solution at P/Q=2/5,r=1 is (S,T)=(1,−2), with all solutions (1−2k,−2+5k). Gap existence, unique Hall integer and orientation require extra hypotheses, correctly retained as limits.

Schrödinger finite-difference quadratic form and Gershgorin intervals are positive under the exact stated ghost boundary condition. The historical negative eigenvalue cannot belong to this matrix; unrelated zeta-zero matching is explicitly unproved.
KMS boundary sign is correct for α_t(B)=e^(itH)Be^(−itH) and F=ω(Aα_z(B)); Laplace resolvent is (sI+iH)^−1 for Re(s)>0. Infinite unconfined hydrogen Gibbs-trace limitations are properly scoped.

Fourier damping separates undamped modes and correctly restricts positive forward-Euler steps. Flow energy and Lax–Milgram calculations are valid under smooth periodic / coercive hypotheses respectively. RG flow formula solves the stated truncated ODE on the connected interval of existence containing t=0.
